description: Sample users of an app: invented clients, players or members so its back office looks full and real without showing anyone real (the students of a yoga studio, the clients of a dog groomer, the players of a ranking): an example app's screenshots, or a studio showing its client how the app will look with people in it, best in its pre (env "pre"). Remove them all with removeAll before the app opens to the public. They have no account: nobody signs in as them and no mail is sent to them; their address ends in @ejemplo.neblla.app. They count in no quota, no «write to everyone» and no export; their visits in no statistic (their sales of example do, marked). action "list"; "create" { name, email? (…@ejemplo.neblla.app, made from the name when left out), photo? (https image), language? ("es") } → { user } (its id is their user id in the app); "update" { user, name?, photo? (null takes it off), language? }; "remove" { user } and "removeAll" (with everything of theirs: bookings, notes, messages, sales of example). What they do, so the back office shows it: "book" { user, set, slot, for?, party? } (a place in a session; a service paid at booking is taken as paid, no money moves), "buy" { user, productId, amount?, at?, until?, series? } (any product: a SALE OF EXAMPLE, marked so, in Ventas, on their card and in the statistics, with no Stripe and no money, out of quotas, the sales CSV and Stripe Tax; it gives what the product gives — files and private content, credits of a pack, a standing place — and fires the purchase webhook with sample: true. at: when, within the last year, to spread the sales over the last days; until: a subscription lives until then and ends (without it, it renews by itself). Refund one with neblla_sales "refund", as a real one: no Stripe, it takes back what it gave and fires the refund webhook), "message" { user, text } (they write to the business in the Buzón), "chat" { user, set, slot, text } (they write in the chat of a session they booked), "score" { user, board, value, seconds? (how long the game took, 60 by default), day? (YYYY-MM-DD, today or up to 30 days back; play the oldest first), data? (for your own check) } (a game of a ranking of neblla.scores, through the SAME checks as a real one: a game a day, the limits, your check; one that does not pass is refused, logged in «Errores y rechazos» and marks them like a real cheat, so the anti-cheats can be shown) → what neblla.scores.submit answers, "save" { user, data } (their neblla.db document, as if they had saved it: replaces it whole). "book" also takes team ("A" or "B", a match) and a session already played (the past of an example); "report" { user, match, winner, score? } (they say a match's result, as neblla.business.matches.report: two that disagree make a dispute), "rate" { user, slot, rating, text?, site? } (they rate the site of a session they were in, as neblla.business.rate), "apply" { user, form } (a business applies to be in the app, as neblla.business.apply). Notes on their card: neblla_business userNote { user, text }; credits by hand: neblla_credits adjust { owner: user }. The screenshots of an example show its sample users only.

at.description: buy: when they bought it (ISO date, within the last year; now by default)

data.description: score: what the game sends to your check; save: their whole document (an object)

day.description: score: YYYY-MM-DD, a game of that day

env.description: "pro" (the published app) or "pre" (its test copy: pre's config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Left out: where the app is, its chosen environment (neblla_promote "status": target, "pro" by default). The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

form.description: apply: what neblla.business.apply takes ({ name, address, timeZone, phone?, about?, photo?, fields? })

seconds.description: score: how long the game took

series.description: buy: which repetition of a standing place that offers several (C285)

site.description: rate: the site of the session

team.description: book: the side of a match (a service with results)

user.description: The sample user's id (create answers it)

name: neblla_sample_users
